# pqc-secrets-node-integration skill

Qwen skill for integrating PQC secrets with Node applications.

## Purpose

- Document how Node apps load PQC-backed secrets without touching disk.

## Ownership

- Local-router PQC integration team.

## Local Contracts

- Secrets loaded in-memory only; never written to `.env`.

## Work Guidance

- Use existing `loadKeysFromEnvironment`/`loadPqcSecrets` paths in `src/`.

## Verification

- Ensure provider keys resolve at startup without logging material.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
